name: LightMemo
description: Native filtered global TDB-SM retrieval and RiverMemo V3, optional Rerank/Jev, with a shared-pool three-track laboratory.
author: VCP

EXCLUDED_FOLDERS.description: 需要屏蔽、任何时候都不搜索的日记文件夹名称，用逗号分隔。

RerankUrl.description: Rerank服务的URL，如果需要使用Rerank功能则必须提供。

RerankMaxDocumentsPerRequest.description: 单次Rerank请求的最大候选数，代码硬上限为25。

RerankMaxConcurrentRequests.description: Rerank小批量请求的最大并发数，限制范围为1到10。

JevRerankPrompt.default: 请选择最值得用于回答当前查询的记忆。请综合考虑逻辑关联、记忆叙事连续性与信息解释力；优先选择能直接回答问题、补足关键背景或维持事件连续性的内容，压低表面词汇重合、重复、跑题或缺乏上下文价值的内容。

JevRerankMaxChoices.description: LightMemo单次Jev精排最大候选数，硬上限255；实际还受2倍K窗口限制。

JevRerankMaxDocumentChars.description: 每篇候选发送给Jev的最大字符数。

invocationCommands.description: Search diary memory with enginemode=rivermemo (default) or knn. Retired TagMemo modes are rejected. query required; maid/folder or search_all_knowledge_bases defines scope. k defaults to 5. Date constraints are preserved. BM25 applies only to RiverMemo; KNN is pure vector retrieval. Numeric tag_boost and core_tags/core_boost_factor configure shared RiverMemo sensing; + suffix is retired. Optional rerank/jev consume at most 2*K; jev wins if both enabled. aimemo/aimemo_preset summarize final candidates. TDB knowledge_base routing remains independent.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」LightMemo「末」,
enginemode:「始」rivermemo「末」,
folder:「始」VCP开发「末」,
query:「始」RiverMemo如何恢复连续记忆中的逻辑链「末」,
k:「始」5「末」,
tag_boost:「始」0.6「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>

invocationCommands.description: command=memory_ab compares TDB original-vector cosine ranking, external Rerank, and RiverMemo V3 using one native snapshot and one filtered candidate pool. query and explicit scope required. k defaults to 5 (maximum 100); candidate_k defaults to 30 (maximum 100, at least k). compare_rerank defaults to true. External Rerank sees the complete bounded common pool, not a consensus 2*K pool. This measures ranking/readout, not exact full-corpus recall. BM25 is transitional candidate-local substring TF evidence, not an independent lexical recall route. Jev remains available in ordinary search, not as a laboratory track.
invocationCommands.example:
<<<[TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
tool_name:「始」LightMemo「末」,
command:「始」memory_ab「末」,
folder:「始」VCP开发「末」,
query:「始」RiverMemo如何恢复连续记忆中的逻辑链「末」,
k:「始」8「末」,
candidate_k:「始」30「末」,
compare_rerank:「始」true「末」
<<<[END_TOOL_REQUEST]>>>
